title: Physicist Christopher Stubbs joins Anthropic's Long-Term Benefit Trust
description: Anthropic announced that physicist Christopher Stubbs has joined its Long-Term Benefit Trust. The trust is part of the company's governance structure.

title: Anthropic pitches AI safety bill that may block a model if 50+ people could be killed
description: TechCrunch reports that Anthropic is proposing an AI safety bill under which a model could be blocked if it could cause the deaths of 50 or more people. The proposal adds to the ongoing policy debate over frontier model regulation.

title: Anthropic's cloud partnerships are getting messy
description: TechCrunch examines the growing complexity of Anthropic's relationships with its cloud providers. The piece looks at how overlapping partnerships are shaping compute access for the company.

title: ChatGPT now lets you lock your chats
description: OpenAI added a feature to ChatGPT that lets users lock their chats. The update is aimed at giving users more control over privacy of their conversations.

title: PHP Armageddon: OpenAI, Google's Wiz find ancient holes, panicking the internet
description: TechCrunch reports that AI-assisted security research from OpenAI and Google's Wiz has uncovered long-standing vulnerabilities in PHP. The findings have prompted concern across the web ecosystem.

title: Meta says Muse has over 10M users, with shopping a top activity
description: Meta says its Muse AI app has passed 10 million users, with shopping among the most popular activities. The milestone comes shortly after the app's launch.

title: Google has joined Amazon in attacking Nvidia's stronghold with AI app developers
description: TechCrunch reports that Google is following Amazon in targeting Nvidia's hold on AI developers. The move signals increasing competition in AI developer tooling and hardware ecosystems.

title: While Amazon blocks AI agents, Walmart rolls out the welcome mat
description: TechCrunch contrasts Amazon's blocking of AI shopping agents with Walmart's decision to welcome them. The divergence highlights differing retail strategies for agentic commerce.

title: US orders federal agencies to remove China's DeepSeek AI from their systems
description: The US government has ordered federal agencies to remove DeepSeek's AI from their systems, according to TechCrunch. The directive is a notable escalation in policy toward Chinese AI models.

title: Copilot model policy API for enterprise, orgs, and teams
description: GitHub introduced a Copilot model policy API for enterprises, organizations, and teams. It lets administrators manage which models are available programmatically.
